script:
set -euo pipefail
echo '=== health emily-claude ==='
bash /home/azureuser/bot-health-check.sh emily-claude
echo
echo '=== keitzer files ==='
ls -la /home/azureuser/.keitzer-bot /home/azureuser/keitzer-* /etc/systemd/system/keitzer-*.service 2>&1 || true
echo
echo '=== emily-claude units ==='
systemctl cat emily-claude-bot.service emily-claude-responder.service
echo
echo '=== emily-claude route ==='
grep -n 'emily-claude/api/messages' /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/openclaw-sdneuro 2>&1 || true
echo
echo '=== listening ports ==='
ss -tlnp | grep -E '127\.0\.0\.1:[0-9]+' | sort -u
echo
echo '=== bot scripts ==='
ls -1 /home/azureuser/*-{bot.py,responder.py,send-to.sh} 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,120p'
